children: Sunshine Silver announced inclusion in the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF, marking broader market visibility after its June IPO.
Common stock will be added to GDXJ effective at market close on September 18, 2026.
Inclusion follows the company's IPO and NYSE debut on June 4, 2026, boosting public profile.
Expected to increase visibility, expand passive ownership and support trading liquidity.
Company remains focused on advancing the Sunshine Mine toward planned return to production in late 2028.
